barks_en: Worthless fools! Out of my way!
We are doomed! Let me out!
There is no victory in the pit.
Why struggle? The crowd only wants corpses.
barks_zh: 挣扎何用？观众只想看尸体。

barks_en: Hahaha! The trumpets sing in purple!
barks_zh: 哈哈哈！号角在唱紫色的歌！

barks_en: Strike harder! Let me feel it!
Pain is the only truth here!
barks_zh: 再用力打我！让我感受它！
痛苦是这里唯一的真理！

barks_en: Don't touch me! You're working for the Ringmaster!
barks_zh: 别碰我！你是马戏团长的走狗！
管好你们自己——我一定要活下去！

barks_en: I will not break before this crowd!
barks_zh: 我绝不会在这群观众面前屈服！

barks_en: Fear nothing! We own the ring!
barks_zh: 无所畏惧！这擂台属于我们！

barks_en: Feel the wrath of a champion!
YES! THE BLOOD FLOWS IN ECSTASY!
